question: Should this protected-label PR be closed as superseded by the merged current-main implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101181, or kept open for a branch-specific delta?
rationale: The source and history show the central fix is already on main, but the `maintainer` label prevents ClawSweeper from auto-closing this PR.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR because current main already contains the same central behavior through the merged superseding PR, and this branch still lacks real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep for a unique delta
options.body: Keep this PR open only if a maintainer wants a specific branch-only change, then require a refresh against current main and real runtime proof before merge.
